purpose: Source material for Play Store screenshot redesign. Each shot is mapped to ASO keyword targets, Play Store slot priority, and suggested headline overlay text.

play_store_strategy.current_problem: Existing screenshots not winning. Listing rewrite shipped 2026-05-19, awaiting Play re-index settle (~14 days). Title misses biggest keyword 'internet speed test' (1.1M Bing/mo).
recommended_play_store_order: Slot 1: 04-network/01 (Network Privacy Report)  OR  02-battery/01 (7.9W power overview)

screenshots.shows: Today's Health Score card (5/10), Streak, Best, Total scans, Scan Device Health button, Get Device Health Report, Verify Someone's Report, Cert/AI/Send action FABs

screenshots.headline_overlay: Free RAM, Clean Storage, Save Battery — in one tap
screenshots.keyword_anchor: phone cleaner alternative, ram booster, storage cleanup

screenshots.shows: Privacy Dashboard score 60/100, Threats Today (screen recording / USB debugging), Today's Tasks (Review app permissions, Free up storage, Restart phone)
screenshots.keyword_anchor: is my phone hacked, privacy scan, spyware detector

screenshots.shows: Smart Recommendations: security system off (risky), Contact customer support, App install caution, Battery + storage focus, Restart daily, Don't install too many apps
screenshots.headline_overlay: AI tells you exactly what to fix

screenshots.shows: Power Consumption card — current 7.9W, 'High Usage - Battery Draining Fast' warning, App Power Monitor (Grant Permission CTA), Power Statistics section start
screenshots.headline_overlay: Your battery in WATTS, not just percent
screenshots.keyword_anchor: battery health, battery tester, watts per app

screenshots.shows: Highest Usage 7.9W, Component Breakdown (Battery 4.5W/-9%/hr, Display 2.0W/-4%/hr, Cellular 0.8W/-1.6%/hr, RAM 0.5W/-1.1%/hr), Current Level: High

screenshots.shows: Per-component watt readouts: NFC, CPU (4/4 cores), Camera, Audio (perm req), GPS (perm req), Bluetooth (perm req) — plus 'How Much Battery Does Your Camera Use?' test
'Find Your Perfect Brightness Level' test (Fast Sweep + Full Sweep), Permission Required for Modify System Settings, 'How Fast Processing Drains Your Battery' card start

screenshots.shows: Security Dashboard B+ (80/100), search box, expandable cards: Device Specifications, Device Spyware & Tracking Test, Processor & Performance, Graphics & GPU Info, Battery & Charging
screenshots.headline_overlay: Every spec + spyware check in one place
screenshots.keyword_anchor: device info, phone specs, spyware detector

screenshots.shows: SIM & Mobile Network, Screen & Display (resolution 1344x2992), Text & Font Settings (scale x1.15), Sensors Available (Goldfish accelerometer etc), Recent System Logs, Date Time & Auto Sync

04-network.label: Network Info Tab

screenshots.shows: Network Privacy Report grade B+ (80/100, Threat Low), Network Reachability card, search box, Network Usage Breakdown (Loading), ISP Details (Loading), ISP Streaming/CDN Servers (Loading)

screenshots.headline_overlay: See how your phone ranks vs the world
